name: branding-cat-face-mooji-wordmark-on-sticker-and-tee
title: Rounded MOOJI wordmark whose Os are eyes and ears rise above, shown as a phone sticker and a tee print
whatItIs: A white slide with corner captions and a black rounded wordmark 'MOOJI' in which the two Os are round eyes with pupils, a small nose blob below and two angled strokes above as ears, then two photos: the mark as a die-cut sticker on an orange phone in a jeans pocket, and the eyes and ears printed on the back of a white tee with 'TOYS FOR ANY PERSON'.
whatItMeans: Cute and cheeky; the wordmark turns into a face, perfect for toys.
techniques: Turn letters into eyes and add ears and a nose.
Print the face on the back of a tee.

vocabulary.definition: Letters arranged to form a face.
A logo that doubles as a mascot.
A sticker cut to the outline of the art.
A graphic printed on the back of a shirt.
